name: DarkPilot
author: akashahmed29

sections.description:
DarkPilot is a modern Dark Mode plugin that lets visitors and administrators switch between light and dark themes instantly. It works with virtually any WordPress theme without requiring custom CSS or coding.

Whether you’re improving user comfort, reducing eye strain, or giving your website a modern appearance, DarkPilot provides an elegant, lightweight, and performance-friendly solution.

Why Choose DarkPilot?

  • One-click installation
  • No coding required
  • Lightweight and optimized for speed
  • Works with almost every WordPress theme
  • Fully responsive
  • Accessibility friendly
  • Easy customization

Features

Free Features

  • One-Click Dark Mode
  • Frontend Dark Mode
  • WordPress Admin Dark Mode
  • Floating Toggle Button
  • Light & Dark Theme Switch
  • Toggle Position Settings
  • Multiple Toggle Icons
  • Toggle Button Size Control
  • Custom Toggle Text
  • Custom Toggle Colors
  • Smooth Transition Effects
  • Keyboard Accessible
  • Mobile Responsive
  • Image Grayscale Option
  • Import Settings
  • Export Settings
  • Reset Settings
  • Lightweight & Performance Optimized

Pro Features

  • 15+ Beautiful Dark Themes
  • 15+ Color Presets
  • 15+ Toggle Button Designs
  • Unlimited Custom Color Palette
  • Automatic Schedule (Time Based)
  • Device Targeting
  • Custom Animation Effects
  • Dark Mode Shortcode
  • Popup Dark Mode Switch
  • Menu Toggle Button
  • Analytics & Usage Reports
  • Tooltip Support
  • Multisite Support
  • Fine Color Adjustment
  • Background Image Darkening
  • Advanced Toggle Animation
  • Advanced Display Rules
  • Premium Support
sections.installation:
1. Upload the darkpilot folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to DarkPilot from the WordPress admin menu.
  4. Enable Dark Mode and customize the settings.
sections.faq:
Does DarkPilot work with every WordPress theme?

Yes. DarkPilot is designed to work with most WordPress themes automatically without requiring custom CSS.

Does it support the WordPress admin dashboard?

Yes. You can enable Dark Mode for the WordPress admin area independently.

Can users switch between Light and Dark mode?

Yes. Visitors can easily switch between light and dark mode using the floating toggle button.

Can I customize the toggle button?

Yes. You can customize:

  • Position
  • Size
  • Icon
  • Text
  • Colors

Is the plugin mobile friendly?

Yes. DarkPilot works perfectly on desktop, tablet, and mobile devices.

Will Dark Mode slow down my website?

No. DarkPilot is lightweight and optimized for performance.
